Services

Twelve areas in which we coordinate enquiries

Liver and kidney transplantation are highlighted because they are prominent in our materials. All twelve services are equally accessible.

View all services

Liver Transplantation

Coordination of communication with transplant centres in Türkiye for patients and families exploring liver transplantation.

  • Receiving your first enquiry and explaining how the coordination process works.
  • Clarifying, in general terms, what kind of information the medical provider will ask you to share — without collecting medical files through the website.
  • Coordinating communication between you and the transplant centre's international patient team.
Learn more

Kidney Transplantation

Organised first contact and communication with kidney transplant teams in Türkiye for international patients.

  • Explaining how an enquiry is handled and what you can expect from the coordination process.
  • Helping you describe your request clearly, without asking for diagnoses or reports through the website.
  • Coordinating communication with the international patient office of a kidney transplant centre.
Learn more

Patient journey

Four clear stages, without promises we cannot make

Every case is different. Timelines, eligibility and results are determined only by the medical provider.

Explore the patient journey
  1. 1
    1Step 1

    Initial contact

    You send a short enquiry with your name, country, preferred language, contact method and the service you are asking about.

  2. 2
    2Step 2

    Clarifying the need

    A coordinator contacts you to understand your request in non-medical terms: who the patient is, who is supporting them and what you hope to learn.

  3. 3
    3Step 3

    Coordinating with the medical provider

    If you choose to continue, we coordinate communication with a suitable medical provider.

  4. 4
    4Step 4

    Travel arrangements and follow-up

    After the medical provider gives its guidance, travel and follow-up arrangements are discussed according to the service available and the scope confirmed for your case.

Roles

How HEALIX MEDICAL helps — and what remains with the hospital

What HEALIX MEDICAL coordinates

  • Receiving your first enquiry and explaining the process
  • Clarifying your request in non-medical terms
  • Coordinating communication with the medical provider
  • Explaining how medical files are shared securely, when requested
  • Discussing travel arrangements only within a confirmed scope

What the licensed hospital and doctors decide

  • Diagnosis and medical evaluation
  • Eligibility and acceptance of a case
  • Treatment plan, procedures and risks
  • Medical costs and treatment duration
  • Clinical care and medical follow-up

Questions

Common questions before you start

General, non-medical information. Questions about diagnosis, eligibility, treatment or organ donation law must be answered by the medical team and competent authorities.

See all questions
What does HEALIX MEDICAL do?

HEALIX MEDICAL coordinates communication and the patient journey for international patients seeking medical services in Türkiye. We are not a hospital and do not provide medical care.

How do I start?

Use the short contact form to send your name, country, preferred language, contact method and the service you are asking about. A coordinator will contact you using the method you chose.

Should I send my medical reports through the website?

No. The website form is only for a first enquiry. If a medical provider later needs records, a separate secure channel will be explained to you, including who can access the files.

Who decides whether I can be treated?

Only the licensed hospital and medical team can decide on diagnosis, eligibility and treatment after their own evaluation.

Ready to take the first step?

Send a short enquiry with your contact details. Please do not include medical reports.

We handle your details according to our Privacy policy.
